+/*
+ * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com
+ *
+ * ReverseGeocodingManager.swift
+ * miataru
+ *
+ * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2025-08-22.
+ */
+
+import Foundation
+import CoreLocation
+
+/// ReverseGeocodingManager provides address lookups for coordinates with a simple in-memory cache.
+/// It keeps the public API tiny and safe to use from SwiftUI views.
+final class ReverseGeocodingManager: NSObject, ObservableObject {
+    static let shared = ReverseGeocodingManager()
+
+    private let geocoder = CLGeocoder()
+    private let cache = NSCache<CacheKey, CacheValue>()
+    private let queue = DispatchQueue(label: "com.miataru.reversegeocoding", qos: .userInitiated)
+
+    /// Minimum time to treat a cached address as fresh
+    private let cacheTTL: TimeInterval = 60 * 30 // 30 minutes
+
+    private override init() {
+        super.init()
+        cache.countLimit = 256
+    }
+
+    /// Performs reverse geocoding and returns a short, user-friendly place string.
+    /// - Parameters:
+    ///   - latitude: Latitude in degrees.
+    ///   - longitude: Longitude in degrees.
+    ///   - horizontalAccuracy: Accuracy radius in meters. Used to coarsen and reduce churn.
+    /// - Returns: A concise place description like "Berlin, DE" or "123 Main St, Berlin".
+    func lookupAddress(latitude: Double, longitude: Double, horizontalAccuracy: Double) async -> String? {
+        let key = CacheKey(latitude: latitude, longitude: longitude, accuracy: horizontalAccuracy)
+        if let cached = cachedValue(for: key) { return cached.string }
+
+        let location = CLLocation(latitude: latitude, longitude: longitude)
+        do {
+            let placemarks = try await geocoder.reverseGeocodeLocation(location)
+            guard let placemark = placemarks.first else { return nil }
+            let text = Self.format(placemark: placemark)
+            setCachedValue(text, for: key)
+            return text
+        } catch {
+            return nil
+        }
+    }
+
+    // MARK: - Formatting
+    private static func format(placemark: CLPlacemark) -> String {
+        // Prefer locality + country, fallback to administrativeArea or name
+        let city = placemark.locality ?? placemark.subLocality
+        let admin = placemark.administrativeArea
+        let countryCode = placemark.isoCountryCode
+        let street = placemark.thoroughfare
+        let house = placemark.subThoroughfare
+
+        // Try to build a compact but helpful line
+        if let street, let house, let city {
+            return "\(street) \(house), \(city)\(countryCode.map { ", \($0)" } ?? "")"
+        }
+        if let city, let cc = countryCode {
+            return "\(city), \(cc)"
+        }
+        if let admin, let cc = countryCode {
+            return "\(admin), \(cc)"
+        }
+        return placemark.name ?? [placemark.country, placemark.ocean, placemark.inlandWater].compactMap { $0 }.first
+            ?? NSLocalizedString("place_unknown", comment: "Fallback label when reverse geocoding returns no useful name")
+    }
+
+    // MARK: - Cache
+    private func cachedValue(for key: CacheKey) -> CacheValue? {
+        if let value = cache.object(forKey: key), Date().timeIntervalSince(value.timestamp) < cacheTTL {
+            return value
+        }
+        return nil
+    }
+
+    private func setCachedValue(_ string: String, for key: CacheKey) {
+        cache.setObject(CacheValue(string: string, timestamp: Date()), forKey: key)
+    }
+
+    private final class CacheKey: NSObject {
+        let latBucket: Int
+        let lonBucket: Int
+        let accBucket: Int
+
+        init(latitude: Double, longitude: Double, accuracy: Double) {
+            // Bucket by ~50m to reduce churn; widen with accuracy
+            let bucketSize = max(50.0, min(1000.0, accuracy))
+            latBucket = Int((latitude * 111_000.0) / bucketSize)
+            lonBucket = Int(((longitude * 111_000.0) * cos(latitude * .pi / 180.0)) / bucketSize)
+            accBucket = Int(bucketSize / 10.0)
+        }
+
+        override var hash: Int { latBucket ^ (lonBucket &* 31) ^ (accBucket &* 131) }
+
+        override func isEqual(_ object: Any?) -> Bool {
+            guard let other = object as? CacheKey else { return false }
+            return latBucket == other.latBucket && lonBucket == other.lonBucket && accBucket == other.accBucket
+        }
+    }
+
+    private final class CacheValue: NSObject {
+        let string: String
+        let timestamp: Date
+        init(string: String, timestamp: Date) {
+            self.string = string
+            self.timestamp = timestamp
+        }
+    }
+}
+

     private func subtitleText() -> String? {
         guard let cached = cache.getLocation(for: device.DeviceID) else {
             let lastSeen = NSLocalizedString("device_row_last_seen", comment: "Label for the last seen time of a device in the device list row")
             let never = NSLocalizedString("device_row_never", comment: "Default value for never seen device")
             let separator = NSLocalizedString("device_row_separator", comment: "Separator between last seen and distance in device row subtitle")
             let distanceLabel = NSLocalizedString("device_row_distance", comment: "Label for the distance to the device in the device list row")
             let unknown = NSLocalizedString("device_row_unknown", comment: "Default value for unknown distance")
             return "\(lastSeen): \(never) \(separator) \(distanceLabel): \(unknown)"
         }
         // Relative time
         let now = Date()
         let relativeTime = relativeTimeString(from: cached.timestamp, to: now, unitsStyle: .abbreviated)
         // Distance calculation
         guard let myCached = cache.getLocation(for: thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID) else { // <-- cache statt .shared
             let lastSeen = NSLocalizedString("device_row_last_seen", comment: "Label for the last seen time of a device in the device list row")
             return "\(lastSeen): \(relativeTime)"
         }
         let deviceLoc = CLLocation(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)
         let myLoc = CLLocation(latitude: myCached.latitude, longitude: myCached.longitude)
         let distance = deviceLoc.distance(from: myLoc) // in meters
         let usesMetric: Bool
         if #available(iOS 16.0, *) {
             usesMetric = Locale.current.measurementSystem == .metric
         } else {
             usesMetric = Locale.current.usesMetricSystem
         }
         let formattedDistance: String
         if usesMetric {
             let meterUnit = NSLocalizedString("device_row_meter_unit", comment: "Unit for meters in device row distance display")
             let kilometerUnit = NSLocalizedString("device_row_kilometer_unit", comment: "Unit for kilometers in device row distance display")
             if distance < 1000 {
                 formattedDistance = String(format: "%.0f %@", distance, meterUnit)
             } else {
                 formattedDistance = String(format: "%d %@", Int(round(distance / 1000)), kilometerUnit)
             }
         } else {
             let feetUnit = NSLocalizedString("device_row_feet_unit", comment: "Unit for feet in device row distance display (imperial)")
             let milesUnit = NSLocalizedString("device_row_miles_unit", comment: "Unit for miles in device row distance display (imperial)")
             let distanceInFeet = distance / 0.3048
             let distanceInMiles = distance / 1609.34
             if distanceInFeet > 528 { // More than 1/10 mile
                 formattedDistance = String(format: "%.2f %@", distanceInMiles, milesUnit)
             } else {
                 formattedDistance = String(format: "%.0f %@", distanceInFeet, feetUnit)
             }
         }
         let separator = NSLocalizedString("device_row_separator", comment: "Separator between last seen and distance in device row subtitle")
         let lastSeen = NSLocalizedString("device_row_last_seen", comment: "Label for the last seen time of a device in the device list row")
         let distanceLabel = NSLocalizedString("device_row_distance", comment: "Label for the distance to the device in the device list row")
         return "\(lastSeen): \(relativeTime) \(separator) \(distanceLabel): \(formattedDistance)"
     }
+
+    // MARK: - Reverse Geocoding
+    private func fetchAddressIfNeeded(for cached: CachedDeviceLocation) async {
+        if isGeocoding { return }
+        isGeocoding = true
+        defer { isGeocoding = false }
+        let text = await ReverseGeocodingManager.shared.lookupAddress(
+            latitude: cached.latitude,
+            longitude: cached.longitude,
+            horizontalAccuracy: cached.accuracy
+        )
+        await MainActor.run {
+            self.address = text
+        }
+    }
 }
